_default_l: UK-listed company. Annual reports are PDFs on the company website under Investors -> 'Results, Reports & Presentations' (search by COMPANY NAME, not ticker). AnnualReports.com mirrors many. RNS announcements are text pages, not report PDFs — do not save them.
